 Oral Order
3 07-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The accused/petitioners are named in the FIR and apprehending their arrest in connection with Chautham P.S. Case No.90/2023 registered under Sections 366(A)/34, 376 of the of the Indian Penal Code (in short 'I.P.C.') and Section 4 of the POCSO Act.

3. As per the FIR, petitioners along with other co- accused persons kidnapped the minor daughter of the informant, aged about 17 years, where apprehension was raised that she might be killed by the accused persons including these petitioners.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.63299 of 2025(3) dt.07-11-2025 4.

It is submitted that the thrust of allegations qua kidnapping is available against co-accused Suraj Kumar, whereas the allegations against these petitioners including other co-accused persons appears very much general and omnibus.

It is pointed out that even the petitioners were not named through the statement of the victim recorded under Section 183 of the BNSS, where she categorically Sumit Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113296071/
1 stated that out of her own sweet will left her house with co-accused Suraj Kumar.

sentences.text: 5. Learned APP has opposed the prayer of bail.

6. In view of the aforesaid factual submissions and by taking note of the facts as the thrust of allegations prima facie not appears available against petitioners, where the victim also denied the allegations of kidnapping while recording her statement under Section 183 of the BNSS, accordingly,
both the petitioners, above-named, are directed to be released on bail, in the event of their arrest or surrender in the court below within a period of four weeks, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/-
(Rupees Ten Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Khagaria, in connection with Chautham P.S. Case No.90/2023 (G.R. No. 1029/2023) subject to the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.63299 of 2025(3)
dt.07-11-2025 conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the CrPC/under Section 482(2) of the BNSS.
(Chandra Shekhar Jha, J) Pawan/-
